quizzes.title: Automata Basics: QuizLogic Demo
quizzes.description: A small demonstration of finite-state answer validation, regular-language patterns, automatic checking, and score generation.

questions.question: Give a common abbreviation for finite state machine.
questions.explanation: FSM is a common abbreviation for finite state machine.

questions.question: Which language family is described by expressions using union, concatenation, and repetition?
questions.explanation: These operations are used to describe regular languages.

questions.question: Enter any string containing only lowercase letters a or b.
questions.explanation: The pattern [ab]+ is a regular-language rule: one or more a/b characters.
